highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update.
highlights_body: The preview updates the bundled renderer and includes the current HarfBuzzSharp binding-generation model.

breaking.title: Corrected Unicode combining-class enum name
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now CCC132, matching the corrected upstream HarfBuzz name while retaining numeric value 132. Update source references to use CCC132.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed
breaking.body: The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask was removed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

bullets.detail: Aligns the preview line with the Chrome m154 renderer.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
